title: Derived total normalization of the quotient section tensor comparison
statement: Given normalized scalar section data c, a normalized internal tensorator b, and a section tensor isomorphism barB satisfying TensorSectionCondition a T c b barB, every ordinary tensor map with the specified pure-scalar formula extends to a signed-total map on flat-term independent K-flat section pairs, with the prescribed summand and localization-counit equations.

proof.text: The ordinary scalar section isomorphism transports preservation of countable colimits to E. Construct the signed total and its coproduct-inclusion formula using mapBifunctorComparison.
Apply the internal-image counit equation. Take internal inverse images under the termwise section equivalence, transferring K-flatness and flat terms along the counit isomorphisms.
Form the two natural transformations from the tensor localization, model counit and total comparison. Naturality transports their equality along the termwise equivalence counits.

proof_origin.place: Explicit total construction, internal-image evaluation and naturality transport through the termwise section equivalence.

statement_change.old_statement: Given the underlying comparison and its pure-tensor formula, it extends to the normalized signed total on K-flat pairs and satisfies the summand and counit equations.

old_proof.text: Totalize the balancing map with the Koszul sign on each bidegree. Coproduct inclusions give the summand equations, while localization counits give the derived comparison equation.

statement_change.what: The old signature quantified over arbitrary barB without relating it to c or b. Multiplication of barB by -1 where 1 differs from -1 changes the required equation with all hypotheses unchanged. Add TensorSectionCondition, and adapt the sole caller to construct a compatible conjugate by a proved categorical theorem. The caller and all targets retain their signatures.
